deferral_rationale: Reconciler round-1 demotion (binding PASS-side on this finding): plan v2 §4.1 defines the cap contract as 'at most 200 (member, pin) staleness reads per report' — the code implements exactly that (cap check at verify_report.py:1698 before the ls-tree/merge-base/log triplet; constant comment at :1540-1542 accurately states what is bounded). The plan's timing gate is the timed CLI probe with the ~10s kill bar (plan line 153), measured ~4.1s on the largest real body — PASSED. Per-row pin-resolution rev-parse calls are uncapped, but the byte-untouched pre-existing _same_line_pins in check_committed_under_claims runs the same uncapped per-row resolution on every report already, so the new check adds no new asymptotic class and capping only its resolution would not bound the gate. Real observation, not a plan violation; a resolution budget is a standing recommendation for a future round, not required before advance.
